## Salmon
Salmon - wicked-fast transcript quantification from RNA-seq data
Salmon index -
Salmon quant - 

```
salmon index   -t transcriptome.fa   -i salmon_index   -k 31
mkdir salmon_out
salmon quant   -i salmon_index   -l A   -1 fastq/SRR23955797_1.fastq   -2 fastq/SRR23955797_2.fastq   -p 12   --validateMappings   -o salmon_out/
```
